title: Parts Standards and Customer-Pay Scope by Repair Class — Insurance Claim Repairs
content:
Under Insurance Claim Repairs the parts a repair may use, and the customer-pay work that may be added to a claim repair order, are set per repair class.

| Repair class | Original-equipment parts required | Non-original parts disclosure signed before work (where the insurer's estimate specifies such parts) | Recycled (used original-equipment) parts allowed | Customer may pay to upgrade an insurer-specified part to original equipment | Most labor hours of customer-pay work on unrelated damage per repair order |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Claim Repair | No | Required | Yes | Yes | 4.0 |
| Standard Claim Repair | No | Required | Yes | Yes | 8.0 |
| Major Claim Repair | No | Required | Yes | Yes | 8.0 |
| Structural Claim Repair | Yes | Not required | No | No | 6.0 |
| Certified Structural Claim Repair | Yes | Not required | No | No | 6.0 |
| Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair | Yes | Not required | No | No | 4.0 |

### Notes

- **Original-equipment parts required** states whether replacement parts must be original-equipment parts.
- **Non-original parts disclosure** states whether the customer must sign the non-original-equipment parts disclosure before work starts when the insurer's estimate specifies such parts.
- **Part upgrade** states whether the customer may pay the difference to upgrade an insurer-specified part to an original-equipment part.
- **Unrelated-damage hours** is the most labor hours, to one decimal place, of customer-pay work on damage unrelated to the claim that may be added to one repair order.

### Reading the pattern

The three non-structural classes share one parts profile and the three structural classes the opposite one; the unrelated-damage limit is the one column that varies within each group, from 4.0 hours in Express Claim Repair to 8.0 hours in Standard and Major Claim Repair, and from 6.0 hours in the two lower structural classes to 4.0 hours in Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair.
